description: Get a structured profile for any entity (person, project, team, concept, company). Returns their role, facts, relationships, recent activity, and confidence level. Use this to understand 'who is X?' or 'what is project Y?'

entity.description: Name of the entity to look up (e.g. 'Kevin', 'Acme Corp', 'auth service')

volume_id.description: Volume ID. Uses default if not set.

name: profile
